title: Embeddings bulk incentive structure experiment and QSA response draft
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: validate a hybrid bulk-incentive model for embeddings and reranking that preserves per-vector economic clarity for self-serve customers while offering tiered discounts and contractual credits for enterprise. We need a pilot experiment, technical bill-of-materials for metering, and a QSA-ready draft response covering how batch credits, slotless consumption, and audit trails will be accounted for in contracts.

Hypothesis: Introducing a two-axis pricing instrument (per-vector base + volume credit buckets with time-decay rollforward) will increase enterprise committed spend by ~18% while keeping marginal per-vector revenue delta within 10% for large-scale rerank workloads.

Success metrics: (1) Commit conversion rate from pilot cohort >= 12% within 90 days, (2) Average realized unit price change <= 10% for top-5 customers, (3) Billing accuracy incidents <= 0 for pilot, (4) QSA questionnaire sign-off by legal/security on pilot terms.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Experiment design doc published and shared with Sales/Legal/Eng; 2) Billing engineering mocks for meter outputs and ledger lines; 3) QSA response draft completed with evidence artifacts; 4) Pilot cohort of at least 3 customers recruited and terms executed; 5) Telemetry dashboard tracking committed vs actualized units live.
steps: 1. Draft pricing variants (A: shallow slab discount, B: burst credits + rollover, C: slotless hybrid) and expected economics model; 2. Review with Billing Eng to map to ingestion metering (ENG-71144) and invoice schema; 3. Legal & Security to co-author QSA responses and required artifact list; 4. Identify 3 pilot customers via AE motion and craft contract templates; 5. Implement metering instrumentation and Looker dashboard; 6. Run 90-day pilot and collect telemetry; 7. Postmortem + roll/no-roll recommendation.
risk_and_mitigation:
Risk: Ambiguous metering could cause billing disputes. Mitigation: require explicit invoice payload mapping and 30-day internal reconciliation window.
Risk: QSA flags on credit accounting. Mitigation: include immutable ledger export and KMS-backed signing of billing deltas.
Risk: Large customers gaming batch windows. Mitigation: telemetry anomaly detection and contract caps on retroactive credits.
